cli:cli-machine-contract:command-help.stdout:
matrix
  Input JSON: { "baseDate": "2026-06-08", "kind": "국채" }
  Optional fallback: { "fallback": "previous-available", "lookbackDays": 10 }
  baseDate maps to 기준일 and accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, or YYYYMMDD.
  kind maps to 종류 and accepts one of these Korean labels or source codes:
    10 = 국채
    20 = 지방채
    30 = 특수채
    40 = 통안채
    50 = 은행채
    60 = 기타금융채
    70 = 회사채(무보증)
    80 = 회사채(사모)
  fallback=previous-available tries the requested date once, then walks backward until rows are found.
  lookbackDays defaults to 10 and may not exceed 31.
  Run kinds to print this list as JSON, CSV, or TSV.
  Result rows include 적용대상채권, tenors 3M through 50Y, and dateResolution metadata.

CLI example:
  ytm matrix --base-date 2026-06-08 --kind 국채 --format json

cli:cli-machine-contract:help.stdout:
KIS-NET YTM Matrix toolset

Operations:
  matrix: fetch YTM Matrix rows for a 기준일 and 종류.
  kinds: list accepted 종류 codes and Korean labels.

Accepted 종류 values:
  10 = 국채
  20 = 지방채
  30 = 특수채
  40 = 통안채
  50 = 은행채
  60 = 기타금융채
  70 = 회사채(무보증)
  80 = 회사채(사모)

Source terms are preserved where official: 기준일, 종류, and 적용대상채권.
Use validateInput(operationName, input) before execute when integrating in-process.

CLI usage:
  ytm matrix --base-date <기준일> --kind <종류> [--fallback previous-available] [--lookback-days <days>] [--format json|csv|tsv] [--pretty]
  ytm kinds [--base-date <기준일>] [--format json|csv|tsv] [--pretty]
  ytm help <command>

Output:
  json is the default and prints one JSON object. csv and tsv print tabular success rows. Failures always print one JSON object to stdout and exit non-zero. Help diagnostics for invalid invocations are written to stderr.

operations.name: matrix
operations.label: Lookup KIS-NET YTM Matrix
operations.description: Fetch YTM Matrix rows from KIS-NET for a 기준일 and 종류. The source-native 종류 may be a Korean label such as 국채 or a source code such as 10.

baseDate.description: 기준일. Accepted forms: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, or YYYYMMDD.

kind.description: 종류. Use a Korean source label such as 국채 or a source code such as 10.

fallback.description: Optional unavailable-date policy. Use previous-available to try the requested 기준일 once, then walk backward until KIS-NET returns matrix rows.

lookbackDays.description: Maximum prior calendar days to try when fallback is previous-available. Defaults to 10.

limitations: KIS-NET decides available 기준일 data and may return an empty matrix for non-business days, holidays, or unavailable dates.
With fallback=previous-available, the requested 기준일 is still tried first; previous dates are probed only after KIS-NET returns no rows.
Yield cells containing '-' are returned as null while preserving the raw cell text.
operations.resultSummary: Returns the resolved 종류, tenor labels, one row per 적용대상채권, numeric yield values, raw source cells, source request metadata, and date-resolution metadata.

operations.name: kinds
operations.label: List KIS-NET YTM 종류 values
operations.description: List source 종류 codes and Korean labels for the KIS-NET YTM Matrix. When baseDate is supplied, values are refreshed from KIS-NET's init endpoint; otherwise the inspected source list is returned without a network request.

baseDate.description: Optional 기준일 used to refresh 종류 values from KIS-NET. Accepted forms: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, or YYYYMMDD.

limitations: Without baseDate this command returns the source list observed during tool inspection instead of performing a live request.
operations.resultSummary: Returns accepted 종류 codes and labels.

commandHelp.matrix:
matrix
  Input JSON: { "baseDate": "2026-06-08", "kind": "국채" }
  Optional fallback: { "fallback": "previous-available", "lookbackDays": 10 }
  baseDate maps to 기준일 and accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, or YYYYMMDD.
  kind maps to 종류 and accepts one of these Korean labels or source codes:
    10 = 국채
    20 = 지방채
    30 = 특수채
    40 = 통안채
    50 = 은행채
    60 = 기타금융채
    70 = 회사채(무보증)
    80 = 회사채(사모)
  fallback=previous-available tries the requested date once, then walks backward until rows are found.
  lookbackDays defaults to 10 and may not exceed 31.
  Run kinds to print this list as JSON, CSV, or TSV.
  Result rows include 적용대상채권, tenors 3M through 50Y, and dateResolution metadata.

operation.name: matrix
operation.label: Lookup KIS-NET YTM Matrix
operation.description: Fetch YTM Matrix rows from KIS-NET for a 기준일 and 종류. The source-native 종류 may be a Korean label such as 국채 or a source code such as 10.

baseDate.description: 기준일. Accepted forms: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, or YYYYMMDD.

kind.description: 종류. Use a Korean source label such as 국채 or a source code such as 10.

fallback.description: Optional unavailable-date policy. Use previous-available to try the requested 기준일 once, then walk backward until KIS-NET returns matrix rows.

lookbackDays.description: Maximum prior calendar days to try when fallback is previous-available. Defaults to 10.

limitations: KIS-NET decides available 기준일 data and may return an empty matrix for non-business days, holidays, or unavailable dates.
With fallback=previous-available, the requested 기준일 is still tried first; previous dates are probed only after KIS-NET returns no rows.
Yield cells containing '-' are returned as null while preserving the raw cell text.
operation.resultSummary: Returns the resolved 종류, tenor labels, one row per 적용대상채권, numeric yield values, raw source cells, source request metadata, and date-resolution metadata.
